title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Genesis Governance Audit — message 1

metadata.content:
Post-M50 Roadmap Position Audit

Current source HEAD is 823a5c2043fef9dbe42bb3c54683f434226b47a0 on feature/genesis-historical-replay, commit fix(education): preserve authoritative empty runtime truth. The branch resolves exactly to that commit; no later source change is being assumed in this audit. M50’s final contract is important: after a successful Runtime read, empty Education artifacts, competencies, and timeline remain empty rather than being repopulated from certified/model fixtures.

1. Current roadmap position

The program is now past Historical Replay, Genesis Corpus construction, and the Repository Knowledge Seeding handoff boundary. The next constitutional stage is Educational Corpus certification—not Chief Agent activation and not yet Initial Competency.

CA-005 establishes the mandatory sequence:

Historical Replay → Genesis Corpus → Repository Knowledge Seeding → Educational Corpus → Initial Competency → Activation → Continuous Learning.

It defines the Educational Corpus as the approved pre-activation curriculum and makes Initial Competency dependent on that approved corpus.

Current implementation has advanced beyond the July reconciliation position. The branch now contains first-class deterministic Historical Replay and Genesis machinery, and the replay architecture contract explicitly carries the lifecycle through Evidence Admission, governed Knowledge Operations, Canonical Knowledge, Organizational Memory, and toward Educational Corpus.

More decisively, there is now a dedicated GenesisRepositorySeedCertification. It can certify the repository-native seed corpus, partition evidence by governance eligibility, and produce the exact evidence IDs authorized for seeding. But that same production contract deliberately records:

broaderEducationalCompleteness: "NOT_CERTIFIED".

That field identifies the roadmap boundary almost perfectly.

⸻

2. Prerequisites already certified or implemented sufficiently to precede the next stage

* Vision and constitutional direction are established. Vision 2050 defines permanent institutional memory, continuously compounding engineering capability, Knowledge as Age II, Chief Agent/Organization as Age III, and curriculum/replay/archive as enduring capabilities. It does not authorize skipping the education boundary to reach the Chief Agent.
* The Learning Constitution is established. CA-005 explicitly governs Genesis, Repository Knowledge Seeding, Educational Corpus, Initial Competency, Activation, and Continuous Learning as separate ordered states.
* Historical Replay is no longer merely a missing conceptual prerequisite. HISTORICAL_REPLAY_CONTRACT_V1.md now establishes identity, deterministic ordering, manifests, chronology, source authority, provenance, and the boundary at Evidence Admission. This materially supersedes the older CA-005/reconciliation statements that replay identity, ordering, checkpoint, and deduplication had no formal contract.
* Genesis/Repository Knowledge Seeding has advanced to explicit certification. GenesisRepositorySeedCertification distinguishes CERTIFIED, INCOMPLETE, and BLOCKED, requires exact replay progress, checks evidence/governance correspondence, and permits only knowledge-seeding-eligible evidence to enter the automatic seeding set.
* The seeding-to-Knowledge-Manufacturing boundary is explicitly certified. GenesisRepositorySeedHandoffCertification verifies each seed evidence item correlates to exactly one existing manufacturing run. It explicitly states that compiler, validation, Knowledge Package, Canonical Review, Canonical Knowledge, Organizational Memory, and educational outcomes are subsequent lifecycle concerns.
* Current-policy production consumption is governed and fail-closed. GenesisRuntimeCanonicalConsumptionView returns no canonical knowledge when the replay designation is unset/invalid or historical-output governance is unavailable; only a designated current-policy replay produces an active consumption view.
* An Education runtime layer already exists. EducationalAdmissionPolicy accepts canonical knowledge only through explicit status/governance/provenance checks and rejects test, fixture, synthetic, certification, and unapproved material.
* Educational coverage has a real governed measurement contract. The requirements include Vision 2050, Platform Constitution, document governance, CA-001 through CA-005, Knowledge Constitution material, Chief Agent operating boundaries, conversation curriculum, and business/domain curriculum.
* M50 closed the presentation/runtime-authority leak. Builder Education no longer substitutes modeled artifacts, competencies, or timeline entries when Runtime truth is legitimately empty.

So the previous roadmap assumption that Genesis or Repository Knowledge Seeding itself must still be built is no longer accurate.

⸻

3. Prerequisites still missing

The missing prerequisite immediately in front of Initial Competency is an explicit certified Educational Corpus.

Current Education runtime code can project educationally admissible Canonical Knowledge and measure curriculum coverage. KnowledgeEducationProjectionService builds artifacts and timeline from admitted Canonical Knowledge and derives module completion from coverage requirements. But its snapshot is just a generated projection with source: "canonical-knowledge"; it does not establish an approved/versioned Educational Corpus identity, corpus certification, human acceptance, or competency certification.

The repository itself makes the distinction explicit: Educational Coverage Requirements measure “admitted curriculum presence only” and “do NOT measure Chief Agent mastery or competency.”

Remaining post-corpus prerequisites therefore include:

* an approved/versioned Educational Corpus;
* explicit certification of its required authority, scope, provenance, supersession/current-policy state, gaps, and conflicts;
* Initial Competency evaluation against the approved constitutional domains;
* a real competency certification mechanism rather than curriculum/UI status;
* human acceptance of that competency result;
* a consistently governed activation authority;
* only then, Chief Agent activation.

CA-005 is unambiguous: education is complete only when the approved Educational Corpus is identified/versioned, Genesis has passed governed knowledge controls, Initial Competency has actually been assessed, gaps remain visible, and human governance accepts the assessment. Activation then additionally requires completed/accepted Initial Competency and explicit human authorization.

The current curriculum file does contain named competency objectives and status values, but those are part of the certified Education UI/runtime curriculum topology. They cannot be interpreted as the constitutional Initial Competency certification, especially because the measurement contract explicitly disclaims mastery measurement.

⸻

4. Conflicting or stale planning records

Several repository planning records must not be treated as current truth.

IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER_V1.md is demonstrably stale. It still says Project Registry, Runtime execution, Preview, Dashboard, Builder, Developer Workspace, Designer Workspace, AI Workspace, Repository Intelligence components, and numerous other implemented systems are “Not Started.” Its own claim that it “reflects actual implementation progress” is no longer credible against source HEAD.

CHIEF_AGENT_OPERATIONAL_LEARNING_MODEL.md contains a historically useful but stale component-status table. It reports Historical Replay Engine and Genesis Corpus Registry as missing and Repository Knowledge Seeder as only partial. HEAD now contains those concrete subsystems plus repository-seed certification and handoff. Its statements that Educational Corpus Registry, Competency Evaluator, Competency Certification, and activation machinery are missing remain directionally valid; its Genesis/replay status does not.

CA-005’s original Historical Replay gap inventory is partially superseded. Article XV records replay identity, ordering, checkpoint, deduplication, resumability, and completion as unresolved. HISTORICAL_REPLAY_CONTRACT_V1 plus the current Genesis implementation subsequently supplied formal contracts for those areas. That old gap record is historical constitutional context, not an accurate implementation-status report.

The Repository Knowledge Seeding specification contains a known authority-order conflict. It places repository implementation above Platform Constitution and governing architecture. CA-005 explicitly identifies that conflict and preserves the higher constitutional hierarchy. The specification remains useful for seeding mechanics, but that precedence clause must not drive roadmap decisions.

CONTINUATION_CONTEXT.md is plainly obsolete operational history. It still identifies feature/lumina-runtime-hardening and Runtime lifecycle hardening as the current phase. It does not describe the current branch or program position.

The older IMPLEMENTATION_BACKLOG_V1.md is still useful as architectural decomposition, but it is not trustworthy as a live completion tracker. The more authoritative Final Implementation Roadmap establishes Historical Engineering Recovery as mandatory and places agent maturity after the knowledge foundations; repository reality now determines how far through those objectives the program has actually progressed.

⸻

5. Exact repository evidence establishing sequencing

The sequencing is not inferred from conversation history. It is directly established by the following repository chain:

CA-005 Article V: Repository Knowledge Seeding transforms Genesis into validated educational knowledge through evidence capture, normalization, validation, canonical governance, Organizational Memory, graph, retrieval, and context.

CA-005 Article VI: the next named object is the Educational Corpus, an approved pre-activation curriculum with known authority, approval state, ownership, scope, version, and higher-authority relationship.

Current source: GenesisRepositorySeedCertification explicitly says repository seed certification does not certify broader educational completeness.

Current source: GenesisRepositorySeedHandoffCertification explicitly terminates its responsibility when certified Genesis evidence successfully crosses into the existing Knowledge Manufacturing run; educational outcomes are later lifecycle concerns.

Current source: Education already possesses governed admission and curriculum-coverage measurement, providing the substrate for the next boundary.

Current source: that coverage explicitly does not constitute competency.

CA-005 Article VIII: only after an approved/versioned Educational Corpus exists does Initial Competency assessment become constitutionally complete.

CA-005 Article IX: only after completed and accepted Initial Competency may human activation occur.

That makes the current source-level sequence:

M50 complete → Educational Corpus certification → Initial Competency assessment/certification → human acceptance → Activation.

There is no constitutional or repository basis for jumping directly from M50 production-consumption governance to Chief Agent activation.

⸻

6. Smallest next production milestone

M51 — Governed Educational Corpus Certification

That is the smallest already-authorized bounded objective.

Its production outcome should be a Runtime-owned, deterministic, versioned certification of the Educational Corpus assembled from already-governed current-policy educational material, with sufficient evidence to answer:

* exactly which curriculum artifacts constitute this corpus version;
* their authority, approval state, provenance, scope and governing version;
* which certified Genesis/repository-seed lineage they derive from where applicable;
* which CA-005 curriculum requirements are satisfied;
* which requirements are missing;
* which conflicts or unresolved authority conditions remain;
* whether the corpus is CERTIFIED, INCOMPLETE, or BLOCKED;
* and a stable corpus/certification identity suitable for the later Initial Competency milestone.

This milestone should reconcile the already-existing GenesisRepositorySeedCertification / handoff contracts with the already-existing Education admission and coverage machinery. It should certify the educational input, not claim that an agent has learned or mastered it.

That also resolves the current semantic hole between:

broaderEducationalCompleteness: "NOT_CERTIFIED"

and

CA-005’s requirement for an approved Educational Corpus version before competency assessment.

7. Explicit exclusions from M51

M51 should not include Chief Agent activation; Initial Competency scoring or certification; competency examinations; human activation authorization; Continuous Learning; autonomous missions; Chief Agent autonomy expansion; specialist-agent work; another Historical Replay implementation; another Repository Knowledge Seeder; reopening M49 governance recovery; reopening M50 Runtime-authority compatibility; redesigning Canonical Review or Organizational Memory; inventing business/domain curriculum merely to obtain 100% coverage; fabricating missing conversation evidence; or treating unresolved curriculum gaps as a reason to manufacture completion.

Missing conversation, business, domain, or other curriculum should be reported truthfully as corpus gaps unless an already-governed source exists. CA-005 explicitly allows unresolved knowledge to remain visible, and the current coverage contracts already model those gaps instead of fabricating progress.

Audit conclusion: the next program milestone is M51 — Governed Educational Corpus Certification. Initial Competency is the milestone after that. Chief Agent activation remains downstream and is not authorized merely because M49/M50 completed production knowledge-consumption governance. No source change should precede the M51 implementation contract.           Be advised, the original plan was to get Chief Agent. Before activating Chief Agent, we should already have Genesis, meaning korelumina, from day zero starting. So by the time we activate Chief Agent, he already start learning from the beginning, from day zero. And also conversation, since it's external, we still hasn't connected in the learning curriculum.
